name: EM Currencies vs Fed Cycles: BRL, MXN, ZAR (2000–Present)
description: Analyzes Brazilian Real (BRL), Mexican Peso (MXN), and South African Rand (ZAR) performance during Fed hiking vs cutting cycles since 2000. FX pairs are inverted (1/USDBRL etc.) so positive returns = EM currency appreciation. Fed regime is classified using 3-month change in the effective Fed Funds rate: Hiking (≥+20bps), Cutting (≤-20bps), Neutral otherwise. Each currency gets a cumulative return chart with hiking/cutting regime shading, plus a per-currency summary table showing avg annualized return, cumulative return, % of days, and hit rate by regime.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EM CURRENCIES vs FED CYCLES: BRL, MXN, ZAR
# =============================================================================
# Inverted FX returns: positive = EM currency appreciation vs USD
# Fed regime: 3-month change in effective Fed Funds rate
#   Hiking  = rate rose ≥ 20bps over 3 months
#   Cutting = rate fell ≥ 20bps over 3 months
#   Neutral = everything else
#
# Charts: cumulative EM currency return with regime shading (per currency)
# Table:  avg ann return, cum return, % days, hit rate by regime (per currency)
# =============================================================================

# --- Primary FX data ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
bar_idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# FED FUNDS REGIME CLASSIFICATION
# =============================================================================

fed_data = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.FedFunds)()
fed_value = fed_data.result

# Forward-fill sparse FOMC releases to every trading day
fed_filled = ffill(fed_value)

# 3-month calendar shift (~91 calendar days) for regime detection
fed_3m_ago = calendar_shift(period=91D)(fed_filled)

# Rate change over 3 months
fed_3m_change = fed_filled - fed_3m_ago

# Regime flags (threshold: ±20bps over 3 months)
is_hiking  = is_valid(fed_3m_change) and (fed_3m_change >= 0.20)
is_cutting = is_valid(fed_3m_change) and (fed_3m_change <= -0.20)
is_neutral = is_valid(fed_3m_change) and (fed_3m_change > -0.20) and (fed_3m_change < 0.20)

# =============================================================================
# INVERTED FX RETURNS (EM currency perspective)
# =============================================================================
# close = USDXXX (USD per EM unit, or EM units per USD)
# Inverted return: appreciation of EM currency = -1 * USD/EM return
# daily_ret_em > 0 means EM currency strengthened vs USD

prev_close = close >> 1
daily_ret_em = (prev_close - close) / prev_close   # = -(close - prev_close)/prev_close

# Guard against nulls on first bar
daily_ret_safe = daily_ret_em if is_valid(daily_ret_em) else 0.0

# Cumulative return (additive, starts at 0)
cum_ret_em = cumulative()(daily_ret_safe)

# =============================================================================
# REGIME-FILTERED RETURNS (for summary table)
# =============================================================================

# Hiking regime
ret_hike   = where(is_hiking,  daily_ret_em)
ret_cut    = where(is_cutting, daily_ret_em)
ret_neut   = where(is_neutral, daily_ret_em)

# Hit rate: 1 if currency appreciated (ret > 0), 0 otherwise — filtered by regime
hit_hike   = where(is_hiking,  1.0 if daily_ret_em > 0.0 else 0.0)
hit_cut    = where(is_cutting, 1.0 if daily_ret_em > 0.0 else 0.0)
hit_neut   = where(is_neutral, 1.0 if daily_ret_em > 0.0 else 0.0)

# Days-in-regime counters (for % of days)
day_hike   = where(is_hiking,  1.0)
day_cut    = where(is_cutting, 1.0)
day_neut   = where(is_neutral, 1.0)

# =============================================================================
# REGIME BAND SERIES (for chart shading via is_band)
# =============================================================================
# is_band=True: non-zero = shaded region, zero = no shading

hiking_band  = 1.0 if is_hiking  else 0.0
cutting_band = 1.0 if is_cutting else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# CHART: Cumulative EM Currency Return with Regime Shading
# =============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Cumulative Return vs USD (Hiking = Blue Band, Cutting = Gray Band)',
    category='BRL Performance',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='BRL Cumulative Return', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Hiking Cycle', color=Color.Blue, is_band=True, area=True),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cutting Cycle', color=Color.Slate, is_band=True, area=True)
    ])
)(bar_idx, cum_ret_em, hiking_band, cutting_band)

xy_lines(
    title='Cumulative Return vs USD (Hiking = Blue Band, Cutting = Gray Band)',
    category='MXN Performance',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='MXN Cumulative Return', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Hiking Cycle', color=Color.Blue, is_band=True, area=True),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cutting Cycle', color=Color.Slate, is_band=True, area=True)
    ])
)(bar_idx, cum_ret_em, hiking_band, cutting_band)

xy_lines(
    title='Cumulative Return vs USD (Hiking = Blue Band, Cutting = Gray Band)',
    category='ZAR Performance',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ZAR Cumulative Return', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Hiking Cycle', color=Color.Blue, is_band=True, area=True),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cutting Cycle', color=Color.Slate, is_band=True, area=True)
    ])
)(bar_idx, cum_ret_em, hiking_band, cutting_band)

# =============================================================================
# SUMMARY TABLE: Avg Ann Return, Cum Return, % Days, Hit Rate by Regime
# =============================================================================
# Rows: Hiking / Cutting / Neutral
# Cols: Avg Ann Return | Cum Return | % Days | Hit Rate
#
# Avg Ann Return = Mean(daily_ret) * 252  → computed via Mean agg * 252 scaling
# We pass daily_ret_em * 252 so Mean agg gives annualized avg
# Cum Return = Sum of daily returns in regime
# % Days = Sum(day_flag) / Count(all_days) — approximated via Mean of day_flag * 100
# Hit Rate = Mean(hit_flag) * 100

ann_ret_hike = ret_hike * 252.0
ann_ret_cut  = ret_cut  * 252.0
ann_ret_neut = ret_neut * 252.0

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='BRL vs USD: Performance by Fed Regime',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Hiking Cycle', 'Cutting Cycle', 'Neutral'],
        col_headers=['Avg Ann Return', 'Cum Return', '% of Days', 'Hit Rate'],
        cells=[
            # Row 0: Hiking
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Row 1: Cutting
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Row 2: Neutral
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='BRL Performance'
)(ann_ret_hike, ret_hike, day_hike, hit_hike, ann_ret_cut, ret_cut, day_cut, hit_cut, ann_ret_neut, ret_neut, day_neut, hit_neut)

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='MXN vs USD: Performance by Fed Regime',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Hiking Cycle', 'Cutting Cycle', 'Neutral'],
        col_headers=['Avg Ann Return', 'Cum Return', '% of Days', 'Hit Rate'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='MXN Performance'
)(ann_ret_hike, ret_hike, day_hike, hit_hike, ann_ret_cut, ret_cut, day_cut, hit_cut, ann_ret_neut, ret_neut, day_neut, hit_neut)

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='ZAR vs USD: Performance by Fed Regime',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Hiking Cycle', 'Cutting Cycle', 'Neutral'],
        col_headers=['Avg Ann Return', 'Cum Return', '% of Days', 'Hit Rate'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='ZAR Performance'
)(ann_ret_hike, ret_hike, day_hike, hit_hike, ann_ret_cut, ret_cut, day_cut, hit_cut, ann_ret_neut, ret_neut, day_neut, hit_neut)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS: Regime transitions
# =============================================================================

# Detect regime entry transitions (pulse on first bar of each regime)
prev_hiking  = is_hiking  >> 1
prev_cutting = is_cutting >> 1
hike_start   = is_hiking  and not prev_hiking
cut_start    = is_cutting and not prev_cutting

fed_chg_display = where(is_valid(fed_3m_change), fed_3m_change)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Fed Hiking Cycle Begins',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='3M Rate Change (bps)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='EM Daily Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(hike_start, fed_chg_display, daily_ret_em)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Fed Cutting Cycle Begins',
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='3M Rate Change (bps)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='EM Daily Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(cut_start, fed_chg_display, daily_ret_em)
